description: Geometry expectations for docs/ios/SIMULATOR_GATE.md step 8. Values are constant + piCoefficient * pi (mm^3 / mm). Read by the onecad-app oracle (tests/ios_simulator_artifacts.rs) and re-checked by cargo xtask ios-simulator-gate.

artifacts.name: mac-plate
artifacts.description: Reference plate the oracle authors headlessly on macOS (60 x 40 rectangle, centred 6 mm hole, fully constrained, extruded 4 mm); the simulator round-trip test opens it.

artifacts.name: mac-plate-resaved
artifacts.description: The simulator's Save As of mac-plate after it regenerated in-process; must keep mac-plate's document, feature records and sketch.

artifacts.name: plate
artifacts.description: The reference plate modelled through the iPad UI; its sketch plane and orientation are the test's choice, so only extents are fixed (X and Y unordered).

artifacts.name: plate-fillet
artifacts.description: plate with one 4 mm vertical outer edge filleted: a constant-radius blend on a straight 90 degree edge removes (1 - pi/4) r^2 L.

artifacts.name: plate-chamfer
artifacts.description: plate with one 4 mm vertical outer edge chamfered: an equal-distance chamfer on a straight 90 degree edge removes d^2 L / 2.
